title: Use Conservation of Momentum
text: The conservation of momentum suggests that $$p_{\text{before}}=p_{\text{after}}$$ in the horizontal direction. Here, $$p_{\text{before}}=0$$ and $$p_{\text{after}}=m_{\text{shell}}v_{\text{shell}}\cos20.0**\circ+m_{\text{cannon}}v_{\text{cannon}}.$$ Take the shell's horizontal direction as positive, so the cannon's recoil velocity is negative.
